title: Direct Conditioning of Audio Diffusion Transformers on fMRI Reveals Cortical Contributions to Sound Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.12603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing audio from brain activity remains challenging. Existing brain-to-audio pipelines typically map neural responses to predefined stimulus representations before synthesis. While recent work in the visual domain has explored direct conditioning on brain activity, this approach has not yet been extended to audio diffusion models. We introduce MAAS (Multi-Area Auditory Synthesis), an end-to-end framework that conditions a pretrained audio diffusion transformer on ROI-wise fMRI responses without first supervising a decoder to predict an external stimulus representation. MAAS uses region-specific projections and learned brain tokens to condition Stable Audio through a dedicated cross-attention pathway. On a 7T fMRI dataset, we demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines, including two-stage fMRI-to-latent conditioning, across both acoustic and semantic evaluation metrics. In addition, we introduce a fidelity metric ground

translated_title: 音频扩散Transformer对fMRI的直接条件化揭示皮层对声音重建的贡献
translated_abstract: 从大脑活动中重建音频仍然具有挑战性。现有的脑信号到音频流程通常先将神经响应映射到预定义的刺激表征，然后再进行合成。尽管视觉领域的近期工作已探索了对大脑活动的直接条件化，但这一方法尚未被扩展到音频扩散模型中。我们提出了MAAS（多区域听觉合成），这是一个端到端框架，它将预训练的音频扩散Transformer以逐ROI（感兴趣区域）的fMRI响应作为条件，而无需先监督训练一个解码器来预测外部刺激表征。MAAS利用区域特定的投影和可学习的脑部token，通过专用的交叉注意力通路对Stable Audio进行条件化。在7T fMRI数据集上，我们在声学和语义两类评估指标上均展示出相对于基线方法（包括两阶段fMRI到潜在空间条件化方法）的一致改进。此外，我们还引入了一个保真度指标……
tldr: 该论文提出MAAS端到端框架，直接以逐区域fMRI响应作为条件驱动预训练音频扩散Transformer，无需中间刺激表征预测，在声学和语义指标上均超越基线方法，并揭示了皮层各区域对声音重建的贡献。
